notes.title: We're off!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Sky Shepherd is now available on Steam! Thank you for everyone who's followed our development. We hope you enjoy the game.

Please post any comments, screenshots, or whatever you feel like on our community board. We're happy to hear from you and your feedback is important to us!

Be sure to check out our website (boxcastlegames.com) to learn more about the amazing team that brought Sky Shepherd to life! 

Noelle
Boxcastle Games
